_meta.purpose: The fixed English sentences of the evidence packages (data/pipeline/evidence/). pipeline/evidence.py fills the placeholders with numbers that are already in the package and writes the sentences next to them. No sentence is written by a language model and no sentence holds a number that is not a field of the same block.
_meta.wording_rule: A sentence says what was recorded and what was not, with the number of tests behind it and the unit of every value. It does not judge a material, an atmosphere or the amount of evidence. A sentence about tests recorded outside the stated objective says that they are not counted for the need.

format.text: '{field}' is replaced by the value of the field. '[field|one|many]' is replaced by 'one' if the field equals 1 and by 'many' otherwise. A field that is not listed under 'fields' for the section, or that is empty when the sentence is used, stops the run.
format.when: A list of conditions [field, operator, value]; the sentence is used only if all hold. Operators: ==, !=, >, >=, <, <= (the table OPS of run.py). An empty value (null) can only be compared with == and !=.

sections.status: once per need block; exactly one sentence must apply
sections.need: once per need block; every sentence that applies is written, in this order
sections.gap: once per gap code of the need block; 'code' is the gap code, with placeholders allowed; exactly one sentence must apply
sections.indicator: once per indicator group of the need block; exactly one sentence must apply. 'each_value' is filled once per value of the group and the results, joined by 'join', become the field 'values'.
sections.documented: once per entry of documented_elsewhere of the need block; exactly one sentence must apply

format.order: In a need block the sentences are written in the order status, need, gap, documented, indicator.

package_meta.note: Counts of recorded NASA PSI tests. Team computation, not a NASA conclusion and not safety guidance.

index_meta.note: List of the evidence packages: the scenarios of scenarios.json, then every oxygen bin x pressure bin of coverage.json. Status per need is the same value as in scenario_needs.csv and atmosphere_cells.csv. Team computation, not a NASA conclusion and not safety guidance.

cell.label: Oxygen {o2_label}; pressure {pressure_label}
cell.note: One cell of the coverage grid (coverage.json): the oxygen bin {o2_bin} and the pressure bin {pressure_bin}. The bin edges are the team's choice. No flow range and no gravity level are set. Oxygen bins: {o2_rationale} Pressure bins: {pressure_rationale}

fields.o2_rationale: rationale of the oxygen bins in coverage.json
fields.pressure_rationale: rationale of the pressure bins in coverage.json

population.usable: the tests usable for this need
population.recorded: all tests that record the variables this need requires, including tests that are not counted as evidence because their investigation does not state this need as an objective
population.in_scope: the tests within the scope of this need that record every required condition, with or without an outcome, from investigations that state this need as an objective

need.gravity_level: environment.gravity_level; empty if the environment sets none
need.other: counts.other; the same number as usable_elsewhere.tests
need.matched_flow_in_range: counts.matched_flow_in_range; counted over the tests of tier atmosphere or oxygen_only
need.matched_flow_not_recorded: counts.matched_flow_not_recorded; counted over the tests of tier atmosphere or oxygen_only
need.matched_same_gravity: counts.matched_same_gravity; counted over the tests of tier atmosphere or oxygen_only
need.matched_added_gas: counts.matched_added_gas; counted over the tests of tier atmosphere or oxygen_only
need.need_reading: reading of the need (needs.json); empty if none
need.need_note: note of the need (needs.json); empty if none

gap.gap: the gap code; the fields of 'need' are available too

indicator.label: label
indicator.population_text: indicator_text.population of this file for the population
indicator.values: the values of the group, each written with 'each_value'; only where the sentence has 'each_value'

value.stat: stat: min, median, max or count

documented.doc_said_in: documented_elsewhere[].said_in: a field of the PSI record or a reference item id
